Title: hetpaleis leest voor (hetpaleis reads aloud)
Description:
Every first Sunday of the month, we make sure hetpaleis is extra cosy.

Six well-known and lesser-known artists read aloud from their favourite children’s book. This is followed by a (craft) workshop based on the story that’s just been read.

PS: coming and going is no problem, and you don’t have to sit still either.

Title: Zwerflicht (Wanderlight)
Description:
Once, an old woman gave me a little boat in a bottle. That little boat had been stuck inside with glue. I say, ‘Thank you.’ And she says, ‘Never forget that sometimes there’s a sea inside an empty bottle.’ In Zwerflicht , the Fratelli seek a way out when innocence has vanished. Innocence that fades along with the light in the eyes. Because sometimes things happen that you, as a young person, have no control over, and what do you do then? How can you still see, in a dark room? How do you fix a crack in the head or glue back a body that’s broken?

Artistic director of Tutti Fratelli and actor Nico Sturm and theatre-maker, writer and performer Mokhallad Rasem are the ideal guides on this wondrous journey through hidden beauty.

Title: Eigenlijk zijn jullie hier te jong voor (You’re actually too young for this)
Description:
The ultimate adult has it all figured out, understands how everything works and has an answer ready for every question, pays bills and insurance, can assess risks and handles responsibilities well. On the outside you can’t tell, but inside this adult is thinking about stuffing themselves with paprika crisps, gaming all day in their pyjamas and riding safely on the back of Mum’s bike.

After Niet echt, wel waar (an ode to theatre), Onzin voor gevorderden (an ode to science) and Alles wat je moet weten (an ode to adolescence), Fernand’s new show zooms in on how young people view adults – and vice versa. Are adults really adults? Or do they just pretend to be adults at work? And what does it mean to suddenly have to ‘behave’ when the child inside you is still jumping around wildly?

Title: Stok Paard Prins (Stick Horse Prince)
Description:
Drum roll! Clarion call! Heroic battles! Gigantic castles! Kissing princesses awake! Wedding dresses! True love! Romance! Welcome to the sweet dreams of Stok Paard Prins .

A humorous, fairy-tale-like performance about embarking on adventures, trying, failing and trying again. About searching for love. And finding it where you least expected it.

Title: How to raise Pinocchio?
Description:
Pinocchio is a puppet who suddenly comes to life and wants to explore the world on his own. But the more people tell him what to do, the harder it becomes to figure out what he really wants.

How to Raise Pinocchio? is about growing up and finding your way while everyone around you already thinks they know how it’s done. The people around you impose ideas on you about what choices to make, who you should or shouldn’t associate with, and how you should behave.

A play about peer pressure, expectations, and the search for your true self.

Title: DRUMS
Description:
DRUMS is an energetic musical dance performance in which three dancers draw the audience into a whirlwind of beats and rhythms. They bring the space to life with a mix of dance, percussion and pure playing power.

In an intimate, circular setting, you find yourself right in the thick of the action: sounds and playful percussion wash over you. Almost effortlessly, the dancers draw you into an exciting experience. You feel the pulse and see the rhythms!

Choreographer and dancer Ilke Teerlinck previously created the heart-warming and energetic dance production Zullen we samen... at tout petit. Once again, she has chosen to collaborate with Gold Mayanga, a captivating dancer with roots in urban dance. Anneleen Nickmans, who also danced in Niet vallen , completes the trio.
